scope: Single-computer default application catalogue and picker; no classroom association deployment.
validation: Common format categories, cached filtering and association refresh
Candidate picker selection, empty-list fallback and cancellation using simulated installed apps
Win7 native-picker call replaced by a harmless test double
Windows 11 supported per-app link encoding and older-Windows fallback
Application opening and window closure never count as a successful default modification
No registry policy deployment or UserChoice writes in the new feature
limitations: Linux/Mono GUI tests do not validate native Windows association changes.
No real Windows defaults, logon policies or security product settings changed in tests.
Windows 10 and earlier Windows 11 still require selection/confirmation in system settings.
No antivirus engine scan or certificate signing performed.
